_comment: Reviewed historical findings for check_no_secret_material.py SEC-REPO-03. Each entry is keyed by (blob SHA, pattern, SHA-256 of the matched text), so it cannot drift onto other content and a DIFFERENT finding in the same blob still fires. The matched text is stored only as a hash and a masked form, so this file does not itself contain the strings it excepts. Reviewed 2026-11-18: every entry is a contact-SHAPED test fixture or a log echo of one; no credential, key or PEM block was found anywhere in the history.

exceptions.reason: Fixture in the early concurrency driver from the same period. Typed for a test, not taken from any data. NOT claimed to be unassigned: the 0912-0917 prefixes are allocated Iranian mobile prefixes, so the number may belong to a real subscriber. It is not a credential, so there is nothing to rotate or revoke. The file no longer carries it; removing it from history needs a force-push, which is prohibited on this branch, so that is a Product Owner decision (register item REPO-HIST-CONTACTS).
